primary_copy_variations.copy: Luxury isn't just for the owners. At Pawché, we believe every dog deserves a sovereign standard of living. From couture pieces in The Wardrobe to heirloom jewelry in The Vault, elevate your companion’s world to the level of your own. Experience the collection at pawche.store.

Pure gold-tone accents. Hand-selected crystals. Architectural design. The Vault at Pawché is not a collection—it’s a statement of status. For the dog who demands more than the ordinary, offer them the extraordinary. Shop the Atelier today.

Your dog lives for luxury, too. Introducing The Wardrobe by Pawché: editorial-grade fashion for the modern canine. Designed in Obsidian and Gold, our couture pieces are crafted for the spotlight. Don't just dress them. Enshrine them.

They are more than family. They are your greatest companions. Reflect their inner royalty with a brand that understands the true meaning of pet luxury. Pawché: because the finest things in life should be shared. Explore our curated collections.

Rare. Refined. Returning to the Atelier. Limited pieces from our latest curation are now available. Ensure your companion stands out in the sovereign standard of Pawché. Visit pawche.store before the collection is claimed.

tiktok_scripts.title: The Obsidian Reveal
tiktok_scripts.visuals: Slow-motion, high-contrast shots of a black Doberman or Great Dane in a dark studio. Golden light catches a collar from 'The Vault'. No sound except a deep, rhythmic bass line.
text_overlay: Your Dog Lives for Luxury, Too.
tiktok_scripts.hook: Close-up on a gold-plated buckle snapping shut.

tiktok_scripts.title: A Day in the Life (Pawché Edition)
tiktok_scripts.visuals: A cinematic montage of an urban high-rise morning. An owner puts on a designer watch; then puts a Pawché couture harness on their dog. Walking through a luxury lobby. The gold hardware on the leash glinting in the sun.
tiktok_scripts.hook: Owner's hand and dog's paw side-by-side on a marble floor.

tiktok_scripts.title: The Craftsmanship Detail
tiktok_scripts.visuals: Extreme macro shots of stitching on a velvet bed, the weight of a gold-tone bowl, and the texture of a silk-lined coat. ASMR sounds of fabric and metal.
tiktok_scripts.hook: The sound of a heavy gold bowl being placed on a marble floor.
